title: I made a free draw-and-guess game for Android, added a fun solo mode. Not able to grow through...any suggestion
author: GuessKetch
selftext:
Hi all. I'm new to all this and this is my first published game.   
The game idea is simple and we already play in our families, I just put it in an app. There are other game apps that do the same, but I have added things that makes it unique including a solo feature.

The game is like one person draws, everyone else races to guess, each on their own phone. You join with a room code, 2 to 8 players, no account. If you're alone, there's a solo mode where the game sketches doodles and you name them against the clock. There's also a corporate jargon category, because someone should have to draw "boil the ocean".

To be upfront: it's Android only for now, and it has ads (banner, a full-screen ad after a game, optional rewarded ones, none during a round).

Its been almost 3 weeks since release, doing a bit of marketing through social media, but apart from me and family no one has downloaded. I don't know if the app is not good or no one is finding about it.

Any suggestions?

[Game link](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.CHAYAN.guessketch&hl=en_IN)
